global_summary_cn: 当前流动性状态为：趋紧（Risk Off）。宏观流动性环境正处于“完美风暴”的熊市阶段。DXY走强（97.1），美债10年期收益率上升（4.24%），VIX走高，共同指向全球资金流向美元避险资产，风险资产承压。市场新闻主体是极度看跌的，主要由机构抛售驱动：比特币ETF在两周内流出28亿美元，大量投资者处于水下，矿企面临亏损压力，同时ETH和SOL经历严重的Lows技术性跌破。虽然MicroStrategy的Saylor选择在成本价附近买入（提供锚定），且资产RSI值处于极度超卖区间（ETH 19.3），暗示短期内可能出现强劲的技术性反弹（Buy the Dip），但鉴于宏观逆风和持续的抛售压力，任何反弹都可能被视为在进一步筑底前的“卖出集结”。市场处于极度超卖的恐慌阶段。
global_summary_en: Liquidity Status: Tightening (Risk Off). The macro liquidity environment is currently experiencing a "Perfect Storm" bearish phase. A strengthening DXY (97.1), rising US 10Y yields (4.24%), and increasing VIX all point to global capital flowing into safe-haven USD assets, pressuring risk assets. The news narrative is overwhelmingly bearish, driven primarily by institutional selling: Bitcoin ETFs have seen $2.8 billion in outflows over two weeks, massive investor losses, and mining corporations facing stress, alongside severe technical breakdowns in ETH and SOL. Although MicroStrategy's Saylor bought near cost basis (acting as an anchor) and asset RSIs are extremely oversold (ETH 19.3), suggesting a strong technical bounce (Buy the Dip) is highly possible in the short term, any rally might be viewed as a 'Sell the Rally' opportunity before further bottoming, given the persistent macro headwinds and continuous selling pressure. The market is in an extremely oversold panic phase.
